title: Riva 100' Corsaro
description:
This 2019 Riva 100' Corsaro offers a full-beam master cabin on the main deck and four further guest cabins below, with six heads in total. The raised wheelhouse sits forward, with the galley alongside the saloon.

Twin MTU 16V 2000 M96L engines with 1,750 hours give a 24.5-knot cruise and a 27.5-knot top speed. She is lying in Yalikavak, Turkey.
